branchApplicability.rationale: Reverified from complete explorer-verified source and pinned current implementation slots: at block 72423600 (2026-10-10T23:27:13Z), zkUSD proxy 0xfc7e56298657b002b3e656400e746b7212912757 uses 0xf0e28e2d31231e367d0dfe85da19a2dbc4ebb14b and portal proxy 0x8d123a2a0a7c98555931ceda6917b865b7345164 uses 0xd3227d2b5c616dcf566ace0fec42507afef8e28d. Lockdrop._lock transfers amount times input-token decimals to treasury, computes the return amount only from return-token decimals, and passes that same amount to mint and vesting; referral and campaign rates affect separate drop shares, not the return-token conversion. zkERC20.mint directly calls _mint with the authorized caller's nominal amount. Neither current implementation contains a price feed, NAV or exchange-rate quote, price-sensitive redemption conversion, collateral valuation or liquidation engine. The deployed mechanism therefore has no price-sensitive oracle control to score. Arbitrary mint authorization and owner-controlled upgrades remain separate adverse controls; no reserve, redemption, assurance or absence-of-off-chain-liabilities conclusion is drawn.
